title: Steampunk Airship Silhouette
description: A large, rusty steampunk airship with riveted metal plating, gauges, and pipes floats in the sky. Below it stands the dark silhouette of a person with spiky hair looking up, with a gothic castle visible inside the glowing circular window of the vessel.
prompt: A massive rusty steampunk airship with riveted metal, gears, and pressure gauges floats against a dramatic twilight sky. Inside its large circular window a detailed gothic castle is visible under a full moon. Below the vessel stands the black silhouette of a person with spiky hair looking upward, warm orange sunset glow at the horizon, melancholic and mysterious atmosphere, cinematic composition
